newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mitsui Toatsu to build Singapore chemical plant.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Toatsu to build Singapore chemical plant.

text.p: Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals said on Monday it was investing US$66 million to build a bisphenol plant in Singaporey.
The 70,000 tonne per year plant on Pulau Sakra, an island off southwestern Singapore, would be operational in the second quarter of 1999, Mitsui said in a statement.
The new plant would take the company's world-wide production capacity of bisphenol to 210,000 tonnes a year, the statement said.
It said the company has chosen Singapore because of its strategic location in booming Southeast Asia.
